meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用 Centinela (QA) 代理对代码进行深度安全审计，包括 OWASP Top 10 检查、硬编码密钥扫描、依赖漏洞审计等，并生成审计报告。
howto.when: 当你输入 /security-audit 命令，或指定目录如 /security-audit src/auth/ 时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下 src/payments/ 目录的安全性。
say.note: Claude 会对该目录执行安全审计并生成报告。

say.text: 运行安全审计，检查整个项目。
say.note: Claude 会对 src/ 目录进行全面安全审计。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Centinela (QA) agent to perform a deep security audit, covering OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, dependency CVEs, and smart contract checks, then writes a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /security-audit, optionally with a directory path like /security-audit src/auth/.

say_en.text: Audit the security of src/payments/ directory.
say_en.note: Claude will run a security audit on that directory and generate a report.

say_en.text: Run a full security audit on the project.
say_en.note: Claude will audit the entire src/ directory.
